debugData.name: Terrain
debugData.description: The toolkit's terrain material generator (p305) through its JSON route: staticDefines.terrain is the config without its id and the layers' sets (layers' settings: tiling, rotation, tint, normalStrength, roughnessScale; uv WORLD or MESH_UV; blend), the inputs layer0, layer1, … the layers' texture sets ({ textureSet, packing? }, all in one packing). Give a mesh its sets with matOverrides.inputs.
